messages:
incidents-bot: :warning: SEV2 alert - elevated queue length for gpu-pool-us-east1-b (spot) and high 429 rates. Queue ~1.1k, request throttles increasing. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/gpu-pool

nina-oncall: I'm looking. Noting a spike in spot preemptions ~55 in the last 8m. Cluster autoscaler reports errors creating instances. Pulling logs now.

ajay-sre: autoscaler stderr:
```
ERROR: failed to scale up: API error CreateInstances: quota exceeded for project 67890
WARN: backoff for nodegroup "spot-us-east1b": reached backoff limit
```
Possible quota leak or region-level shortage.

leah-infra: Cloud console shows transient inventory shortage for the T4 family in us-east1-b. Can try cross-zone scale to us-east1-c or fall back to pre-warmed on-demand pool.

nina-oncall: Can we re-route latency-sensitive tenants to cpu-fallback for now? We'll degrade model (quantized CPU runner) to keep them alive. Who can flip gateway rule?

deploy-bot: Draft change ready for /v1/chat: set route weight cpu-fallback=1.0 for tenants: medpay, market-ai. Applying canary now. Change id cg-221.

nina-oncall: Canary in, initial p99 for medpay down from 18s -> 3.5s after CPU fallback for a handful of requests. But throughput limited. Queue dropping to ~300. Good progress.

ajay-sre: Spawning emergency on-demand nodes in us-east1-c (non-preemptible) to add capacity. Requesting 6 GPUs. CLI:
```
cloudctl compute instances create --zone=us-east1-c --accelerator type=nvidia-t4,count=1 --type=n1-highmem-8 --labels emergency=1
```
ETA ~7m to join.

infra-alerting: Alert: preemption-rate > 40/min threshold breached at 2006009950. Notifying cloud-provider liaison.

leah-infra: Cloud provider support says inventory limited; provisioning on-demand in another zone is the fastest fix. I've opened an exchange with account team for capacity reservation.

nina-oncall: Heads up: some internal batch jobs still hitting spot pool causing queue backlog. Can we throttle non-critical batch tenants?

ajay-sre: Pushing batch throttling rule: max_concurrent 2 for tenant: internal-batch. Applied.

deploy-bot: Routing change complete and batch throttles applied. Rollout id cg-221.

nina-oncall: Queue stabilized ~80 after CPU fallback + on-demand nodes joining. Some 5xx still trickling but decreasing.

leah-infra: Note: cluster-autoscaler still shows createInstance failures due to quota check in control-plane; root cause likely separate from inventory shortage. Need quota audit.

ajay-sre: Making temporary docs note to enable cross-zone fallback policy so autoscaler can prefer other zones when local inventory low (owner: infra).

nina-oncall: Handoff: I'm going offline in 12m, please monitor the p99 and queue. If preemptions re-spike, revert routing and escalate to provider. Sam (next oncall) please take ownership.

infra-alerting: Created followup alerts: preemption-rate > 10/min, queue > 500, createInstance errors present.

ops-bot: Temporary mitigations in place: cpu-fallback routing, batch throttles, on-demand nodes added. Traffic restored to ~92% baseline.

leah-infra: Post-incident action items:
- Validate quotas and automate quota-bump workflow (owner: leah-infra)
- Implement cross-zone autoscaler fallback policy (owner: ajay-sre)
- Create pre-warmed on-demand buffer for spot volatility (owner: infra-eng)

nina-oncall: Filing incident ticket: https://redwood-tracker/INC-2006. Postmortem requested in 48h.

ajay-sre: I'll draft technical RCA for the autoscaler failures and propose tooling to detect inventory shortages earlier.

nina-oncall: Thanks team. Handing over to infra for followups. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident declared mitigated (temporary). Keeping thread open for final notes.
